meta.title: Week 4 · Philosophers: Louvain and Infomap
meta.weight_definition: Each directed edge weight is the count of links from source article to target article; duplicate directed pairs are summed.
meta.louvain_graph: Directed, weighted graph. NetworkX applies its directed modularity formulation, so no undirected conversion was used for the Louvain partition.
meta.infomap_graph: Directed, weighted graph passed directly to Infomap.
meta.layout_note: The fixed canvas layout uses a weighted undirected projection only for visual placement; it does not affect either partition.
